stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that virtual-reality field trips provide engaging experiences?

options.label: A
options.text: Your breath catches in your throat when your eyes land on the large blue planet—Earth. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: A student can take part in the simulated experience through the use of special equipment, like headsets. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: These trips allow students to experience places they might otherwise never get to visit. (paragraph 3)

options.label: D
options.text: For example, history teachers can use VR to help students understand historic events. (paragraph 4)
